title: Scientific Discoveries by LLM Agents

contributions.purpose: 综述 LLM 智能体自主科学发现的现状
contributions.mechanism: 按能力/多智能体框架/领域应用/端到端系统/评测/挑战六个维度梳理约 47 篇文献,汇总已验证的发现案例(A-LAB 合成 41 种新化合物、Virtual Lab 设计 SARS-CoV-2 纳米抗体等)
contributions.evaluation: 无自有实验;所有数字均转引自被综述文献(如 Agent Laboratory 省 84% 成本、PiFlow 效率 +73.55%)
contributions.domain: LLM agents / AI for Science 综述
contributions.source_quote: This paper reviews the current landscape of LLM-driven scientific discovery, where AI agents can now execute the entire research pipeline, including reading scientific literature, forming novel hypotheses, designing experiments, interfacing with laboratory tools and simulators, analyzing data, and interpreting results.

contributions.purpose: 指出当前 LLM 科学智能体的核心瓶颈与方向
contributions.mechanism: 归纳评测文献(Auto-Bench 等)中跨模型的一致模式,提出因果感知智能体与人机协作两条未来路线
contributions.evaluation: 定性结论:GPT-4/Gemini/Qwen/Claude/Llama 在复杂因果图发现任务上性能一致性下降(转引,无量化)
contributions.source_quote: Despite these successes, significant challenges remain, including performance degradation on highly complex causal reasoning tasks. Future directions point toward creating more robust, causally-aware agents and enhancing human-AI collaboration to accelerate scientific breakthroughs.

notes: desk-reject;协议适配问题:纯综述文,无原创方法/实验/资源,四元组中 evaluation 只能填'转引他文数字',contributions 为归纳所得(无声明列表)。AI 痕迹:正文两处出现未渲染的原始检索元数据 '[240288398 | García-Ortegón et al. | 2021 | Citations: 85]'(引文流水线残留);致谢仅一句 'Generative AI has been used to prepare this manuscript.',无 Agents4Science AI 参与 checklist。各节末尾附通俗摘要框,格式似自动生成。
